## ITPaidMediaBlock type

Represents a Stars paid-media block for Telegram paywalls.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ITPaidMediaBlock = {
    stars: number;
    media: Array<{
        type: `photo` | `video`;
        src: string;
        caption?: string;
    }>;
};
```

## Remarks

This type defines the structure for template-driven paid media declared with `<g-paid-media>` blocks. `stars` is the Stars price unlocking the content (1–25000 per the Bot API `sendPaidMedia` limit); `media` holds 1–10 items of type `photo` or `video` only. Item `src` and `caption` support the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as media captions; the compiled strings are length-checked at runtime before any API call (non-empty `src`<!-- -->, caption at most 1024 chars).

## Example


```typescript
const paywall: ITPaidMediaBlock = {
  stars: 100,
  media: [{type: `photo`, src: `teaser.jpg`, caption: `Bayar untuk membuka`}]
};
```
